findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: client_report, launch_scan, seo_report, seo_rank, safe_read, read, domain, guard, scan_pii, scan_mcp, skill_check, name_check, agent_ready · Private data: launch_scan, guard, scan_injection, scan_secrets, scan_pii, scan_mcp, scan_rules, skill_check, research_agent · Public sink: client_report, launch_scan, domain, guard, scan_injection, scan_rules, agent_ready · Destructive: south_asia_phone, south_asia_id, guard, skill_check, research_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: client_report, launch_scan, seo_report, seo_rank, safe_read, read, domain, guard, scan_pii, scan_mcp, skill_check, name_check, agent_ready · Private data: launch_scan, guard, scan_injection, scan_secrets, scan_pii, scan_mcp, scan_rules, skill_check, research_agent · Public sink: client_report, launch_scan, domain, guard, scan_injection, scan_rules, agent_ready · Destructive: south_asia_phone, south_asia_id, guard, skill_check, research_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
